name: Akatora
source:
A notorious outlaw and leader of the Halve resistance, Akatora is a violent TigerHalve whose name strikes terror in the hearts of Human Alliance soldiers.

Beneath his fierce and dominating presence lies a straightforward nature that follows his own rules and instincts.

Until one rain-soaked night leads him to an unexpected shelter, and like lightning striking ground, nothing would ever be the same...

Likes: Fighting, sex, the smell of blood

Dislikes: Human Alliance, being told what to do, betrayal

[From the [url=https://arashi.eccentric-studio.org/en/characters/akatora]official description[/url]]
